info.title: JobBoard API
info.description: Laravel API for browser-session authentication, job listings, applications, private resumes, and interview scheduling. All JSON responses use a consistent success/data/message/errors envelope.

tags.name: Job Listings
tags.description: Public search and employer-owned listing lifecycle

get.summary: Get platform analytics for the admin dashboard
get.description: Returns compact aggregate metrics, six UTC calendar-month growth buckets, recent activity, and the five latest users. Metric change percentages compare the current period with the preceding equivalent period; null means no previous-period baseline exists.

sanctumSession.name: laravel_session
sanctumSession.description: Stateful browser session established by login. Obtain the CSRF cookie from /sanctum/csrf-cookie before state-changing requests.

xsrfToken.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
xsrfToken.description: Decoded XSRF-TOKEN cookie value required for state-changing browser requests.

SavedOnly.name: savedOnly
SavedOnly.description: Filter published job listings to those bookmarked by the authenticated jobseeker.

JobListingQueryId.name: jobListingId
JobListingQueryId.description: Filter candidate applications to a specific job listing ID.

SearchQuery.name: search
SearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive search term for name, email, or cover letter text.

NotificationCollection.description: Paginated user notifications and unread count

EmptyOk.description: Operation completed without a resource payload

PublicJobListingCollection.description: Paginated compact published listings plus available facets

EmployerJobListingCollection.description: Paginated compact employer listings plus unfiltered status counts

SavedJobListingsOk.description: Saved published job listing IDs for the authenticated jobseeker

JobApplicationCollection.description: Paginated applications plus unfiltered lifecycle counts

Unauthenticated.description: The browser session is missing or expired

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user lacks the required role or ownership

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found or is not publicly visible

ValidationError.description: Request validation or lifecycle transition failed

CsrfMismatch.description: The XSRF token is missing, expired, or does not match the session

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. Too many requests.
